select u.username, u.email, u.real_name, u.user_number, m.major_name, c.class_name from users u left join major m on u.major_id = m.id left join classes c on u.class_id = c.id
and u.role_code != 'ADMIN'
and u.username like concat(#{usersPageQueryDTO.username}, '%')
and u.real_name like concat(#{usersPageQueryDTO.realName}, '%')
and u.user_number like concat(#{usersPageQueryDTO.userNumber}, '%')
